lines.text: Do you listen or listen to?
Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

native.tip: Слушать — “listen to”. Без “to” фраза звучит неправильно.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I listen music every day.”? 😅 По-русски «слушаю музыку» — без предлога, а по-английски нужен “to”. Правильно: “I listen to music every day.”. Послушай Карлос и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “to”. Слушаем что-то — listen to. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.hook: Do you listen or listen to?
en.tip: Listen needs “to”. Without it, the phrase sounds wrong.
en.caption: Do you also say “I listen music every day.”? 😅 In Russian “slushayu muzyku” has no preposition, but English needs “to”. Correct: “I listen to music every day.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
